resources.description: All operations related with workshop executions

resources.name: Get workshop execution by institution id
Definitions
resources.description: All operations related with workshop definitions

resources.contents:
openapi: "3.0.0"

info:
  title: Edubit API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: OpenAPI spec for Edubit's workshops
  contact:
    name: HMCA

tags:
  - name: Definitions
    description: All operations related with workshop definitions
  - name: Executions
    description: All operations related with workshop executions

components:
  schemas:
    ScheduleContents:
      type: object
      properties:
        description:
          type: string
        duration:
          type: integer
    Schedule:
      type: object
      properties:
        order:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScheduleContents'
    TransientWorkshopDefinition:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        schedule:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Schedule'
      required:
        - name
        - schedule
    PersistentWorkshopDefinition:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        name:
          type: string
        schedule:
          type: object
          format: JSON
        enabled:
          type: boolean
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        disabledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - schedule
        - enabled
        - creationDate
    TransientWorkshopExecution:
      type: object
      properties:
        workshopId:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        institutionId:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        scheduledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        activities:
          type: object
          format: JSON
      required:
        - workshopId
        - institutionId
        - scheduledDate
        - activities
    PersistentWorkshopExecution:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        workshopDefinitionId:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        institutionId:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        scheduledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601 (date)
        activities:
          type: object
          format: JSON
        startTimestamp:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        endTimestamp:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        remainingTime:
          type: integer
        participants:
          type: object
          format: JSON
        mentors:
          type: object
          format: JSON
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
      - id
      - workshopId
      - institutionId
      - scheduledDate
      - activities
      - creationDate

servers:
  - url: https://{gateway}.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/{stage}
    description: URL on AWS cloud
    variables:
      #gateway values match stage values
      gateway:
        enum: [ohfjp11sb7]
        default: ohfjp11sb7
      stage:
        enum: [dev, qa, live]
        default: dev

paths:
  /workshops/definitions:
    post:
      summary: Create workshop definition
      operationId: createWorkshopDefinition
      tags:
        - Definitions
      description: Create a workshop definition
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TransientWorkshopDefinition'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Workshop definition successfully created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentWorkshopDefinition'
        '409':
          description: Workshop definition already created
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
  /workshops/definitions/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get workshop definition
      operationId: getWorkshopDefinition
      tags:
        - Definitions
      description: Retrieves the details of a specific workshop definition.
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Workshop definition successfully retrieved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentWorkshopDefinition'
        '404':
          description: Workshop definition not found
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
    patch:
      summary: Update workshop definition
      operationId: updateWorkshopDefinition
      tags:
        - Definitions
      description: Update a workshop definition.
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentWorkshopDefinition'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Workshop definition successfully updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentWorkshopDefinition'
        '404':
          description: Workshop definition not found
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
  /workshops/executions:
    post:
      summary: Create workshop execution
      operationId: createWorkshopExecution
      tags:
        - Executions
      description: Create a workshop execution
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TransientWorkshopExecution'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Workshop execution successfully created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentWorkshopExecution'
        '409':
          description: Workshop execution already created
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
  /workshops/executions/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get workshop execution
      operationId: getWorkshopExecution
      tags:
        - Executions
      description: Retrieves the details of a specific workshop execution.
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: UUID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Workshop execution successfully retrieved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentWorkshopExecution'
        '404':
          description: Workshop execution not found
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
    patch:
      summary: Update workshop execution
      operationId: updateWorkshopExecution
      tags:
        - Executions
      description: Update a workshop execution.
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentWorkshopExecution'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Workshop execution successfully updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentWorkshopExecution'
        '404':
          description: Workshop execution not found
        '409':
          description: Operation could not be completed due to resource state
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
